description:
PLAN.md describes design choices that are not present in the code:

1. PLAN.md §7 (lines 195-204): CalendarEventGetArgs struct receives the four §5.7 extra args. Not in src/. See JMAP-r3pg.2.

2. PLAN.md lines 369-372: ParseEventResult struct named, with parsed:HashMap, not_found:Vec, not_parsable:Vec. Code has 'ParseResult' (different name, src/backend.rs:225).

3. PLAN.md line 332-338: parse_event backend method gated by 'parse' Cargo feature flag. Code has parse_calendar_event_blobs (different name) at src/backend.rs:186, and there is no 'parse' feature in Cargo.toml. CalendarEvent/parse is registered unconditionally at src/lib.rs:131-133.

4. PLAN.md line 408-411: error.rs module containing CalendarSetError (calendarHasEvent, noSupportedScheduleMethods, expandDurationTooLarge, cannotCalculateOccurrences). No error.rs exists. Three of the four error names are not produced anywhere in this crate (see JMAP-r3pg.1, .3, .8).

5. PLAN.md line 396-411 module layout: PLAN names files event_parse.rs, notification.rs, participant.rs. Code has event.rs (containing parse), event_notification.rs, participant_identity.rs. Naming drift.

6. PLAN.md §Capability URI (lines 73-79): three URIs called out — urn:ietf:params:jmap:calendars (registered) plus urn:ietf:params:jmap:principals:availability and urn:ietf:params:jmap:calendars:parse (handled at consumer level). Only the first is exposed (re-exported from jmap-calendars-types). See JMAP-r3pg.21.

Either the code is the source of truth and PLAN.md should be updated to match, or PLAN.md is the design contract and the code has gaps to fill (correlates with JMAP-r3pg.2, .3, .7, .8). The /review-rusty rule prefers updating PLAN.md to reflect current shipped reality, then filing separate issues for the design gaps the PLAN identified.

Recommended action: edit PLAN.md to describe the current code with TODO markers next to design gaps, link the TODOs to the corresponding bd issues filed in this review epic.

JMAP-231o.4 noted the same pattern for jmap-calendars-client. Same hygiene applies here.
